name: Paragraph
summary: A paragraph of body text in one of three sizes.

props.name: size
props.description: Body text at 16, 14 or 12px, all with relaxed leading. The same three sizes HeroUI's Paragraph has.

props.name: color
props.description: Two colours only, like HeroUI: the text colour or the muted one. A closed list protects contrast — both pass AA on every Aurea surface.

props.name: weight
props.description: Overrides the weight of the role. Headings are semibold and body text is regular by default.

props.name: align
props.description: Text alignment. start and end follow the writing direction, so the same value mirrors in RTL.

props.name: truncate
props.description: One line, cut with an ellipsis. Turns the element into a block so the cut has a width to measure against.
